title: Pydantic Evals Framework
summary: This module provides a comprehensive framework for evaluating AI systems, offering tools for defining, configuring, and executing both online and dataset-based evaluations. It includes various evaluator types, LLM-driven dataset generation, and utilities for reporting and telemetry.

nodes.label: Core Evaluation Orchestration
nodes.title: Core Evaluation Orchestration
nodes.description: Manages the overall evaluation process, including online evaluations, dataset execution, and LLM-driven dataset generation.

nodes.label: Specific Evaluator Implementations
nodes.title: Evaluator Type Definitions
nodes.description: Defines various types of evaluators, from simple content checks to LLM-based judges and statistical report generators.

nodes.label: Evaluation Reporting & Telemetry
nodes.title: Reporting & Telemetry Utilities
nodes.description: Provides tools for collecting OpenTelemetry spans, formatting numerical differences, and rendering durations for comprehensive evaluation reports.

nodes.label: Agent Framework
nodes.title: Pydantic AI Agent Framework
nodes.description: The core framework for building and running AI agents, which can integrate online evaluations as capabilities.

nodes.label: LLM Model Abstraction
nodes.title: LLM Model Abstraction Layer
nodes.description: Provides a unified interface for interacting with various Large Language Models, used by evaluators and dataset generation.

nodes.label: Evaluation Data Sinks
nodes.title: External Data Sinks
nodes.description: External systems or services where evaluation results are stored, analyzed, or reported (e.g., databases, dashboards).

nodes.label: OpenTelemetry System
nodes.title: OpenTelemetry Observability
nodes.description: An external observability framework for emitting traces, metrics, and logs related to evaluation events and function executions.

groups.label: Evaluation Orchestration
groups.title: Core Evaluation Orchestration
groups.description: Manages the overall flow of evaluations, from configuration to execution and result dispatch.

groups.label: Evaluator Definitions
groups.title: Defining Evaluation Logic
groups.description: Houses the abstract and concrete implementations of various evaluators for different assessment needs.

groups.label: Reporting & Observability
groups.title: Evaluation Reporting & Observability
groups.description: Provides utilities for collecting telemetry data and formatting evaluation results for clear reporting.

groups.label: External Integrations
groups.title: External System Integrations
groups.description: Represents the external systems and frameworks that interact with or are utilized by the evaluation module.
